$comment: HumanGateway protocol v1.0.0 (2026-08-28). PROTO-FR-04, ARTF-FR-01, ARTF-FR-03.
title: Artifact
description: First-class content object (image, PDF, document, audio). Artifact bytes are stored by the Edge filesystem / Relay PostgreSQL (BYTEA) and referenced by messages by ID + hash — never embedded in the message envelope (PROTO-FR-04).

id.description: Durable artifact ID. Content-hash naming means the same content yields the same hash; the ID is the storage key.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the artifact bytes. Used for content-hash naming, deduplication (skip re-transfer when the hash is already known), and tamper detection on download (ARTF-FR-01, SP-06).

sizeBytes.description: Byte size. Default maximum 50 MiB per artifact (product vision Open Q #7), gateway-configurable; 512 MiB is the protocol ceiling.

mimeType.description: Media type so the receiving app can render or interpret the content (PWA renders by MIME; FlowForge consumes via ArtifactReceived).

filename.description: Original filename, preserved for the recipient.

createdAt.description: When the artifact was first recorded.

artifactReference.title: Artifact Reference
artifactReference.description: A reference to an artifact carried inside a message envelope: ID + content hash plus rendering metadata (filename, MIME type, size). Never the bytes (PROTO-FR-04).

id.description: Artifact ID the receiving gateway resolves in its artifact store.

hash.description: Content hash the receiving gateway verifies after transfer.

filename.description: Original filename, preserved for the recipient.
